answer: A sequential attestation trellis makes Sybil farming expensive: each identity must grow its standing like a grove, one verified task at a time, with every new job building on the previous attestation rather than running in parallel. A newcomer starts on the low mesa of limited rights and climbs only through a chain of useful, checkable work. An attacker can still plant clones, but each clone must pay the full time and compute cost of its own chain, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand times the work, while honest agents keep their earned position.
